Package dev.turboism.sdk.action

Record Class UiActionEvent

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.turboism.sdk.action.UiActionEvent
Record Components:
sourceId - non-blank identifier of the emitting control
value - immutable typed control value
public record UiActionEvent(String sourceId, UiActionEvent.Value value) extends Record
Typed value emitted by a Turboism-owned panel control.

This is an invocation snapshot, not a host control or a persistent binding. It is delivered only when an action originates from a panel contribution.
